how: Single HTML <table> on https://aicodingdaily.com/leaderboard (last update Sep 12 2026): columns # / Model / Total points (max 60) / Avg cost per prompt / Avg time per prompt / Video / Tested with / Points per project (6 sub-cols). score=Total points, cost=Avg cost per prompt (API pricing; 'N/A' when tested via subscription). Effort is the parenthesized level in the model name; rows without one -> default. Number of prompts not stated.

cost_audit.evidence: Leaderboard has six project columns / 60 points; linked methodology describes five projects / 40 points. Four reliability projects have five attempts each; full prompt count and cost denominator remain unverified.
